The automatic sprinkler system activated, causing additional water damage to finished textile rolls in Section C. Fire brigade (Feuerwehr Ingolstadt) arrived within 8 minutes and contained the blaze to the electrical room and adjacent aisles.

damages.item: Replacement of main electrical distribution board and wiring
Professional soot and smoke decontamination of Section B
Damaged raw cotton rolls (Lot #442-A)
Damaged silk fabric rolls (Lot #991-S)
Water damage to polyester-blend stock (Section C)
Heavy-duty industrial shelving unit (Rack 04)
Replacement of damaged sprinkler heads and sensor array
Inventory inspection and grading services
Emergency cleaning of warehouse floor surfaces
Disposal of unusable hazardous smoke-contaminated textiles

incident.location: Commercial unit, 882 Silicon Way, Palo Alto, CA 94304
incident.description: A localized power surge occurred during a lightning storm, bypassing the main surge protector. The surge caused significant failure in the high-precision diagnostic equipment and the central workstation used for micro-soldering repairs.

damages.item: Digital Oscilloscope (Model X-500) - motherboard failure
Precision Micro-soldering Station repair and recalibration
Workstation UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) replacement

incident.location: Gruber Event Space, Getreidegasse 34, 5020 Salzburg, Austria
incident.description: During the post-event breakdown of a private gala, an overloaded power strip in the catering corner short-circuited. Small flames ignited a decorative linen tablecloth. The fire was contained by a staff member using a handheld extinguisher, but smoke damage to the ceiling and surrounding velvet drapery is extensive. Local fire brigade (Salzburg Feuerwehr) attended to ensure no smoldering remained.

damages.item: Smoke remediation and deep cleaning of velvet drapery
Ceiling plasterwork repair and specialized anti-smoke paint
Replacement of catering area power distribution unit and cables
Professional upholstery cleaning for damaged seating
